purpose: Freeze the exact negative/null/phase-boundary analysis before any protected price x shift result exists, so adverse cells are scientific results rather than post-hoc interpretation choices.

input_record.format: JSONL, one record per independent scientific unit per frozen price x shift cell
input_record.value_semantics: The three normalized-point values are supplied by the already-frozen benchmark-specific campaign accounting. This atlas does not invent or refit a reward/cost exchange rate.
input_record.scientific_unit_rule: unit_id must be the campaign's frozen independent unit, never a seed, generated row, tool call or repeated episode

price_lattice.boundary_rule: a phase boundary is a literal edge between adjacent lattice cells whose frozen classification differs; no smoothing, curve fitting or visual interpolation may create a boundary

derived_quantities.regret_guard: a materially negative hindsight regret is an invalid input and fails closed
derived_quantities.cell_max_regret_reference_provenance: existing P12 frozen stop/go maximum-regret threshold; used here as a preregistered diagnostic boundary, not as retroactive proof of robustness

uncertainty.estimand: mean candidate gain over independent scientific units in a cell
uncertainty.randomness: SHA-256 counter stream keyed by the canonical cell key; no runtime or host RNG
uncertainty.cannot_check_rows: excluded from numeric resampling but counted and reported; a cell with zero eligible rows is CANNOT_CHECK

cell_classification_in_priority_order.rule: bootstrap 95% upper bound for mean candidate gain <= 0
bootstrap 95% lower bound for mean candidate gain > 0 AND cell maximum hindsight regret <= 2 normalized points
bootstrap 95% lower bound for mean candidate gain > 0 AND cell maximum hindsight regret > 2 normalized points
all remaining eligible cells, including intervals spanning zero

required_report: all frozen price x shift cells including adverse and CANNOT_CHECK cells
eligible N and CANNOT_CHECK N/reasons per cell
mean gain and 95% interval per cell
mean and maximum hindsight regret per cell
per-stratum direction without pooling away failures
forbidden: changing any price level after outcomes
choosing a different uncertainty method after outcomes
smoothing a failure region into a success region
replacing CANNOT_CHECK with a guessed value
selecting a new strongest baseline from protected outcomes
using the hindsight oracle as a candidate policy

negative_result_interpretation.BASELINE_LOSS: publish as an adverse transfer region; do not retune the same estimand until positive
negative_result_interpretation.POSITIVE_HIGH_REGRET: publish as a resource-location boundary: apparent gain is materially below attainable hindsight performance
negative_result_interpretation.UNRESOLVED_DIRECTION: publish as statistically unresolved at the frozen unit and interval definition
negative_result_interpretation.CANNOT_CHECK: publish the access/accounting/source reason; do not substitute authored or easier cells
